author: jfal064

title: Incredible
body:
I tried this app out on a whim and now all my friends use it too. Sick of being chronically online and this app helped break a lot of habits. Delaying instead of preventing is far more effective since it just makes opening twitter, reddit, or instagram that much more inconvenient. I bought a year of the full version and haven’t looked back. My screen time over the past 3 weeks has plummeted.

I would appreciate a bit more customization with some apps outside of social media. Like preventing me opening Slack outside of work hours, or similar. But as it is, this app is still very effective and packs a whole lot of features, and the price is extremely affordable. I’m sick of apps which offer wellbeing improvements charging an arm and a leg, and this app is a breath of fresh air.

I wish their web browser extension for PC had a few more features, but thats a minor nitpick. 

Incredible app, incredible value.
